title: Validate outbound webhook URLs against a host allowlist
description: The client's notification service sends webhooks to URLs that tenants configure. This change makes endpoint.Validate refuse any URL that could reach an internal or unapproved host before the service sends a request.

acceptance_criteria.text: Only absolute https URLs are accepted; scheme-relative and http URLs are rejected.
The hostname must match an allowlist entry exactly, compared case-insensitively. Subdomains and look-alike hosts are rejected.
URLs with userinfo, an empty host, or an IP-literal host are rejected.
An accepted URL is returned with its path and query unchanged.
